1.web: Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
1.asv: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.

2.web: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
2.asv: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

3.web: and I will cut off the judge from their midst, and will kill all its princes with him,” says Yahweh.
3.asv: and I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith Jehovah.

4.web: Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have rejected Yahweh’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;
4.asv: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have rejected the law of Jehovah, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have caused them to err, after which their fathers did walk.

5.web: But I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
5.asv: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

6.web: Thus says Yahweh: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes;
6.asv: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes—

7.web: They trample on the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and deny justice to the oppressed; and a man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name;
7.asv: they that pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father go unto the same maiden, to profane my holy name:

8.web: and they lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge; and in the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
8.asv: and they lay themselves down beside every altar upon clothes taken in pledge; and in the house of their God they drink the wine of such as have been fined.

9.web: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
9.asv: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

10.web: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
10.asv: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

11.web: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says Yahweh.
11.asv: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazirites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith Jehovah.

12.web: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
12.asv: But ye gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

13.web: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
13.asv: Behold, I will press you in your place, as a cart presseth that is full of sheaves.

14.web: Flight will perish from the swift; and the strong won’t strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
14.asv: And flight shall perish from the swift; and the strong shall not strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;

15.web: neither shall he stand who handles the bow; and he who is swift of foot won’t escape; neither shall he who rides the horse deliver himself;
15.asv: neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself; neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself;

16.web: and he who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says Yahweh.
16.asv: and he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith Jehovah.
